replacement.title: Landing Page Video Content
replacement.definition: The landing page should include the independently requested video content.

patches.decision_note: The extraction routing warning identifies message 72 as introducing video content that is not represented by the current inventory.
Message 101 reports delivery of a final version but does not itself report a runtime failure; lateness is inferred from chronology and should not be encoded as an execution Event.
Review whether the exchange establishes a client-required branded URL or only discusses hosting limitations and optional domain customization.
